tips.situation: Early in a fight or poking with shuriken, ult not ready
tips.tip: Farm Dragonblade by poking the tanks too, not only squishies. Charge it fast.
During blade, go for supports first; quick kills give dash resets and chain the blade.

tips.situation: Pulled blade into a grouped, full-health enemy team or while outnumbered
tips.tip: Don't blade into a full, grouped team. Wait for a pick, an enemy ult, or your team to engage.

tips.situation: About to pull blade vs Ana, Brigitte or other stuns
tips.tip: Before blading, check Ana sleep and nade and Brigitte bash. Blade when they're down.
Slash then dash: swing, then dash through to finish the kill and refresh dash.

tips.situation: Blade dash with no targets left, near a ledge
tips.tip: With no targets left, aim slightly down when dashing so you don't fly off the map.
Move erratically during blade: jump, double jump and strafe so you're hard to hit.

tips.situation: Just got a dash reset from an elimination
tips.tip: After a reset, don't dash instantly. Reposition, then use it on the next kill or to escape.

tips.situation: Used dash to engage a full-health target and got stuck with no escape
tips.tip: Keep dash as your escape unless the combo will kill. Dash to finish, not to start.

tips.situation: Low-health enemy near a teammate's damage
tips.tip: Finish low targets yourself when you can; the kill resets your dash.

tips.situation: Close range burst on a squishy
tips.tip: Burst combo: shuriken fan, dash through, then melee. Fan and dash hit hard together.
Cancel shuriken recovery with a quick melee or dash for faster damage.
Aim primary where the target is walking, not where they are. Shuriken are projectiles.

tips.situation: Dash on cooldown and under fire
tips.tip: Dash is down, so deflect is your defensive button. Deflect, then back off.

tips.situation: Enemy holding fire while you deflect
tips.tip: Cancel deflect early to bait. Enemies often wait it out, so stop and punish.
Vs Orisa, don't bother deflecting her Halt back; deflect her team's follow-up damage instead.
Vs Rein, double jump right after your dash to dodge Earthshatter; deflect his hammer swings.
Vs Sigma, kill with blade then dash out before Gravitic Flux lands.
Vs Ashe, flank without dash, land shuriken, deflect coach gun, then dash plus fan plus melee.
Killing Echo's duplicate doesn't reset your dash. Don't count on it.
Vs Pharah, double jump after dash and use fan at the high ground.

tips.situation: Engaging while enemy Ana has cooldowns
tips.tip: Vs Ana, engage when her nade is down; double jump after dash in blade to dodge sleep.
Don't blade Moira first; she fades out. Punish her during Coalescence instead.
Go in when your team goes in, or right after enemies burn key cooldowns. Not solo.

tips.situation: Walking down main path in enemy sightlines
tips.tip: Take an off-angle or high ground with wall climb instead of walking the main path.

tips.situation: Crossing open ground in hitscan sightlines
tips.tip: Don't cross open ground in view of their hitscan. Use cover and walls.
Low health: disengage to a health pack or your supports, then come back.

tips.situation: Died at the very start of a fight
tips.tip: You died first. Wait for enemy attention to split before committing.
Pair blade with team ults like Nano, Grav or Earthshatter for easy value.
